SELECT
  INV.FICHENO AS DocumentNumber,
  CONVERT(varchar(10), INV.DATE_, 23) AS InvoiceDate,
  CASE INV.TRCODE
    WHEN 1 THEN N'Alış Faturası'
    WHEN 2 THEN N'Satış İade Faturası'
    WHEN 3 THEN N'Satış İade Faturası'
    WHEN 4 THEN N'Alınan Hizmet'
    WHEN 6 THEN N'Alış İade Faturası'
    WHEN 7 THEN N'Satış Faturası'
    WHEN 8 THEN N'Satış Faturası'
    WHEN 9 THEN N'Satış Faturası'
    WHEN 13 THEN N'Satınalma Fiyat Farkı'
    WHEN 14 THEN N'Satış Fiyat Farkı'
    ELSE N'Satış Faturası'
  END AS InvoiceType,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(CLC.CODE)) AS CustomerCode,
  ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(ITM.CODE)), LTRIM(RTRIM(SRV.CODE))) AS ProductCode,
  CAST(STL.AMOUNT AS float) AS Quantity,
  CAST(STL.PRICE AS float) AS Price,
  CAST(STL.TOTAL AS float) AS LineAmount,
  CAST(ISNULL(STL.DISTDISC, 0) AS float) AS Discount,
  CAST(ISNULL(STL.VAT, 0) AS float) AS TaxRate,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(STL.LINEEXP)) AS LineDescription
FROM dbo.LG_421_01_STLINE STL WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN dbo.LG_421_01_INVOICE INV WITH (NOLOCK) ON STL.INVOICEREF = INV.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_421_CLCARD CLC WITH (NOLOCK) ON STL.CLIENTREF = CLC.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_421_ITEMS ITM WITH (NOLOCK) ON STL.STOCKREF = ITM.LOGICALREF AND STL.LINETYPE = 0
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_421_SRVCARD SRV WITH (NOLOCK) ON STL.STOCKREF = SRV.LOGICALREF AND STL.LINETYPE = 4
WHERE STL.CANCELLED = 0
  AND ISNULL(INV.CANCELLED, 0) = 0
  AND STL.LINETYPE IN (0, 4)
  AND INV.LOGICALREF > 0
  AND INV.FICHENO IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(INV.FICHENO)) <> N''
  AND ISNULL(ITM.CODE, SRV.CODE) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY INV.DATE_, INV.FICHENO, STL.LOGICALREF
